description:
phiola is a fast audio player, recorder, converter. Its low CPU consumption conserves your phone's battery.
Features:
• Play audio: .mp3, .ogg(Vorbis/Opus), .mp4/.mov(AAC/ALAC/MPEG), .mkv/.webm(AAC/ALAC/MPEG/Vorbis/Opus/PCM), .caf(AAC/ALAC/PCM), .avi(AAC/MPEG/PCM), .aac; .flac, .wav.
• Record audio: .m4a(AAC), .mp3, .opus; .flac, .wav
• Convert audio files
• Manage your playlists and audio files
• List and edit file tags
• Input: file, directory, HTTP/HTTPS URL, playlists: .m3u, .pls, .cue
• Instant startup time
• Fast (low footprint): keeps your CPU, memory & disk I/O at absolute minimum; spends 99% of time inside codec algorithms
